description.describe_ch: 商業心理學是一門跨領域學科，涵蓋經濟學、行銷學、心理學、社會學和廣告學等領域，它研究商業環境和背景的演變、形成原因、目標和結果可應用於企業行銷，幫助行銷人員了解和把握消費者和群體的需求和行為，以提供符合需求的產品和服務，從而為消費者帶來滿足感並為企業帶來利潤。
description.describe_eh: Business psychology is an interdisciplinary field that integrates economics, marketing, psychology, sociology, and advertising. It delves into the development, drivers, goals, and consequences of the business environment and context. It is relevant to business marketing, empowering marketers to comprehend and grasp the needs and behaviors of consumers and groups, enabling the provision of products and services that satisfy their demands and yield consumer gratification and organizational profits.
